variants.title: An email from Ana
variants.text:
Hi Tom,

How are you? I'm in Bristol now! I live in a small flat with two friends, Kate and Ben. Kate is a nurse and Ben is a cook in a restaurant. The flat is near the river and it's quieter than my old flat in London.

I work in a bookshop from Monday to Friday. I usually walk to work, but when it rains I take the bus. I never work at the weekend.

Last Saturday we went to a concert in the park. The music was great, but it was very cold!

Next month my parents are going to visit me. We're going to have dinner at a famous fish restaurant by the river.

Write soon!
Ana

variants.title: Marta's blog
variants.text:
Hello! My name is Marta and I'm from Seville, in Spain. Now I live in Edinburgh with my cousin, Lucas. He's a student at the university and I'm a waitress in a café.

Edinburgh is colder than Seville, but it's a beautiful city. I always wear a coat, even in summer!

I start work at seven in the morning, so I get up very early. I sometimes go swimming after work.

Last weekend Lucas and I climbed Arthur's Seat, a big hill in the middle of the city. We took a lot of photos.

In December I'm going to go home for Christmas. I'm going to see my family and eat my mum's food!

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.text: Good morning! What can I get you?

dialogue.speaker: Lucía
dialogue.text: Hi. Is there any orange juice?

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.text: Sorry, there isn't any orange juice today. We've got apple juice or lemonade.

dialogue.speaker: Lucía
dialogue.text: An apple juice, please. And I'd like a cheese sandwich.

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.text: Brown bread or white bread?

dialogue.speaker: Lucía
dialogue.text: Brown, please. How much is that?

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.text: That's six pounds twenty.

dialogue.speaker: Lucía
dialogue.text: Here you are. Oh, what time do you close today?

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.text: At half past five. But on Saturdays we close at three.

dialogue.speaker: Lucía
dialogue.text: OK, thanks. I'm coming back on Saturday with my friends!

A cheese sandwich on white bread.

dialogue.speaker: Priya

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant

dialogue.speaker: Priya

dialogue.speaker: Shop assistant

dialogue.speaker: Priya
